source_facts.fact: Neutral Explore does not mount the detail dock.
source_facts.detail: panelOpen requires a selected geography or a coverage/uncertainty view; the panel section is conditional on panelOpen.

source_facts.fact: The null CountryPanel branch can be constructed but is unreachable from neutral Explore.
source_facts.detail: panelContent falls through to CountryPanel with selectedGeo, yet the containing dock is not mounted when selectedGeo is null in overview.

source_facts.fact: Simply broadening panelOpen would expose the wrong title and reserve the existing panel footprint.
source_facts.detail: A neutral fallback currently resolves to Rank ranges; desktop uses a 400px dock and mobile uses a bottom sheet up to 70vh.

source_facts.fact: handleSelect is the single reusable place-selection and URL/history path.
source_facts.detail: It sets selectedCode, applies the existing compact-sheet rule, and uses pushState except inside diagnostic child navigation, where it uses replaceState.

source_facts.fact: Neutral Explore already exposes a persistent map-header action family.
source_facts.detail: Guided tour and Methods & sources are visible 44px actions in the neutral shell.

source_facts.fact: Selected and diagnostic panels already have different Back, Close, and focus behavior.
source_facts.detail: Diagnostic children expose contextual Back; terminal Close restores a map or diagnostic-control focus target and replaces URL state.

live_facts.places_action_compact_cost: At 390x844 and 320x568 the third action wraps, adding 51px versus baseline while remaining 30px shorter than the permanent select.

required_disclosure_semantics.trigger: Visible while open; aria-expanded mirrors placesOpen and aria-controls references explorer-panel-dock.
required_disclosure_semantics.dismissal: Trigger reactivation toggles closed and retains focus; panel Close restores trigger focus.
required_disclosure_semantics.transition_invariant: One local closePlaces helper clears the disclosure before every canonical transition away, including popstate before hydration.

rejected_host.name: hidden empty-panel chooser
rejected_host.reason: It is not mounted in neutral Explore. Making it visible would silently reserve the panel, inherit incorrect fallback navigation, and change the shell before a reader asks for place finding.
